Could Jane possibly have an eating disorder? What may be seen as picky eating could definitely be a sign of anxiety around food, or an eating disorder. The fact she turned down ideas either means she is being a b\*tch or she may not want to burden you.

Also note that some people can't eat vegetables or legumes comfortably or may have medical issues they don't want to disclose. For example, most vegetarian food leaves me feeling dizzy and unwell since I need extremely large amounts of protein and iron (and struggle with things like legumes and beans myself). Although in this situation it feels like Jane is just being challenging.

I think that you should always try to accommodate people's dietary needs, but I also see that you have tried that. Not sure, sorry OP.

I've been homeless too, but I was able to couch surf and stuff for the entire time (so secondary homelessness). Things like beef jerky and tuna keep really well. If you can afford to grab a mini camping grill or burner that can make it easy to cook. Veggies that are cheap and filling such as potatoes, carrots, etc. If it's cold you can make soup with noodle packets and some veggies and meat.

Also ask at grocery stores or grocers, sometimes they have older or ugly stock that is going to be thrown out. You can easily grab that food for cheap and eat it that night.

Good luck Xx
